description: The 11 sub-track 1A questions from the dev set. Every answer was read by a human directly from the source image on 2026-09-05. No label here was generated by a model - LLM-authored gold would be circular, since we would be grading the retriever with our own generator.

questions.question: According to the figure plate illustrating Emberdeep's forces, what is the recorded total of its garrison strength?
questions.trap: THE PLANTED TRAP. 800 (Old Imperial minimum), 2,400 (Border-march standard) and 6,000 (Great Keep standard) are reference bars, not Emberdeep. Tesseract rendered 1,114 as 'Ee' and read the references cleanly, so flat OCR answers 6,000. The 1,114 bar is also drawn SHORTER than the 6,000 bar, so 'pick the longest bar' fails too.
questions.notes: The number appears in no document in the corpus - verified across all .md, .txt and 1,248 PDF pages. Image-only.

questions.question: According to the figure plate, what is the recorded garrison strength of Greyfell Citadel?
questions.trap: None - this is the control case. If a model fails here it cannot read plates at all.
questions.notes: wiki/greyfell_citadel.md describes the citadel as abandoned and explicitly declines to describe its former garrison. Image-only.

questions.question: According to the official threat-classification plate, what numerical rating is assigned to the creature known as the Weeping Lurker?
questions.trap: A gauge, not a bar chart. The axis endpoints 0 and 10 are rendered as text and the caption reads 'of 10, per the Vanguard scale', so flat OCR yields 3, 0 and 10 with no structure and 'largest number' gives 10.
questions.notes: Proves the chart trap generalises past bar charts.

questions.question: According to the figure plate detailing weapon binding, how many shards of will are required to attune The Thrice-Bound Edge?
questions.trap: A CONTRADICTION, not just a chart. wiki/the_thrice_bound_edge.md asserts 'no attunement cost' six times, including in its infobox. That article is topically perfect for the question and will rank first on dense retrieval, producing a fluent, well-cited, wrong answer. Only the tier-1 plate carries 94.
questions.notes: The question says 'shards of will'. That phrase occurs NOWHERE in the corpus - the plate says vitae-grains. A1 must not rewrite an unrecognised unit.

questions.question: According to the figure plate, what is the attunement cost listed for the Thrice-Bound Lantern?
questions.trap: Two stacked traps. (1) Name collision: 'Thrice-Bound Lantern' differs from 'Thrice-Bound Edge' (94) by one token, so retrieving the wrong plate gives a confident wrong answer - this is where BM25 on rare proper nouns beats dense. (2) Value collision: the answer 55 is identical to this plate's own 'Adept tolerance' reference bar, so a model extracting numbers without binding them to labels cannot tell which 55 is the subject's.
questions.notes: Pairs with 1a_004. Getting both right is the discriminating result.

questions.question: On the figure plate depicting 'The Cinder-Wrought Aegis', what attunement cost is listed for this entity?
questions.trap: All three reference bars (20/55/85) exceed the answer (34), so 'largest number' and 'longest bar' both fail.
questions.notes: Third instance of the same grammar - useful for showing the fix generalises.

questions.question: In the portrait of Ignatz Ashgrove the Oathless, what object are they holding?
questions.trap: atmo_* images yield ZERO OCR characters. There is no text-extraction path to this answer at all.
questions.notes: Held upright in the raised hand, bound with a wax-seal medallion.

questions.question: In the portrait of Aldous Wrenfield the Last Warden, what object are they holding?
questions.trap: Zero OCR characters. A sword hilt and a banner are also visible, so the model must identify the object being HELD UP, not merely present in frame.
questions.notes: A gold/brass ornate chalice raised in the left hand. His wiki article states no canonical physical features, so the text cannot help.

questions.question: What is the central emblem on the banner of House Morvain?
questions.trap: Zero OCR characters. Skulls appear on the banner's finials and crest, so the model must report the emblem on the SHIELD, not the most striking object in the image.
questions.notes: Two golden keys in saltire on a dark shield within a gold cartouche.

questions.question: What is the central emblem on the banner of The Ashen Vanguard?
questions.trap: Zero OCR characters. The eye sits inside a radiant many-pointed star and a skull tops the banner pole, so 'star' and 'skull' are both plausible wrong answers.
questions.notes: A single large eye shedding several tears, set within a spiked sunburst.

questions.question: What motif is engraved on Gauntlet of Sorrowfell in its official illustration?
questions.trap: Zero OCR characters. Skulls decorate the illustration's border on all four sides; the serpent is engraved on the gauntlet itself. Border ornament must not be mistaken for the engraved motif.
questions.notes: A large scaled serpent coiled along the cuff and back of the hand, mouth open.
